title: Infrax Renewable IPO Details
intro:
Infrax Renewable IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹40.88 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 32.51 lakh shares aggregating to ₹33.81 crores and offer for sale of 6.80 lakh shares aggregating to ₹7.08 crores.

Infrax Renewable IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 9, 2026 and will close on Sep 11, 2026. The allotment for the Infrax Renewable IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 15, 2026. Infrax Renewable IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 17, 2026.

Infrax Renewable IPO is set final issue price at ₹104 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,49,600 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,74,400.

Smart Horizon Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Shreni Shares Ltd.

Refer to Infrax Renewable IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in September 2024, Infrax Renewable Limited is a solar energy company engaged in providing Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) services for rooftop and ground-mounted solar power projects. The company also supplies a wide range of solar products, including solar PV modules, inverters, and related equipment, and operates as an Independent Power Producer (IPP) through its own solar power plant in Gujarat under a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with PGVCL.

The company offers end-to-end solar solutions covering project design, engineering, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and operation & maintenance (O&M) services. It serves customers across residential, commercial, and industrial segments through an extensive dealer network and has been empanelled as a national vendor under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana. Infrax currently operates warehouses in Rajkot, Ahmedabad, and Kanpur, along with branch offices across Gujarat, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and Uttar Pradesh, with services supplied across multiple Indian states.
As of March 31, 2026, the team comprised 52 permanent employees.
strengths: Proven track record in executing solar EPC projects.
Diversified business model with EPC, solar product distribution, and IPP operations.
Empanelled vendor under PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.
Strong customer, supplier, and dealer network across multiple states.
Strategic warehouse and branch office presence supporting efficient project execution.
Plans for backward integration through in-house solar component manufacturing and recycling.
Experienced promoter team with over 17 years of industry experience.

faqs.question: How to apply in Infrax Renewable IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Infrax Renewable IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Infrax Renewable IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Infrax Renewable IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Infrax Renewable IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Infrax Renewable IPO?
faqs.answer: Infrax Renewable IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,49,600 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Infrax Renewable IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Infrax Renewable IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Infrax Renewable IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Infrax Renewable IPO will be done on Tuesday, September 15, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Sep 16, 2026 . Check the Infrax Renewable IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Infrax Renewable IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Infrax Renewable IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Sep 17, 2026 .
